name: Remote Work Visitor Visa ("Digital Nomad Visa")

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a signed employment contract with a foreign employer, and that the applicant is not taking up employment in South Africa -- authorised under Section 11(1)(b)(iv) of the Immigration Act 13 of 2002 as a prescribed 'remote work' activity on the Visitor's Visa, not as a standalone visa category.
requirements.fix_path: Confirm the employing entity is genuinely foreign-based and secure a signed employment contract.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires proof of sufficient financial means -- a gross salary of no less than ZAR 650,796.00 per year -- evidenced by 3 months of bank statements.
requirements.fix_path: Document gross annual income at or above the current threshold via 3 months' bank statements.

evidence_required.document: 3 months' bank statements evidencing the qualifying income
Signed employment contract from the foreign employer

Completed and signed application form, statement of purpose/duration, valid return air ticket or reservation, passport valid 30+ days beyond departure, proof of fee payment, yellow fever certificate if applicable

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: Working more than 6 months within any rolling 36-month period triggers a South African Revenue Service (SARS) tax-registration requirement based on the 183-day residency threshold.

sources.title: Department of Home Affairs (dha.gov.za) -- Remote Work Visa requirements notice, effective 9 October 2024

notes: STATUS UPGRADED from draft to published in this pass, and a LIVE DATA CORRECTION made: the prior draft cited ZAR 650,976 as the 'majority-corroborated' figure across tier-3 sources, explicitly flagging one outlier source (ibn.co.za) at ZAR 650,796 as a probable typo. Having now fetched the DHA's own official notice directly, the correct figure is ZAR 650,796.00 -- the prior draft's majority-corroborated tier-3 figure was the wrong one, and the outlier it flagged was actually correct. This is exactly the kind of stale/wrong-figure risk this dataset's sourcing discipline exists to catch, and it caught it on a route the dataset itself had already researched once. DURATION CORRECTION: the prior draft described 'up to 12 months initially, renewable annually up to a total of 3 years' (tier-3 framing); the DHA's own notice states the visa is issued for a single term of 'exceeding 3 months to 3 years' with no explicit mention of an annual-renewal structure -- kept as 'renewable: true' since re-application is described elsewhere, but the annual-cycle framing is not repeated here as confirmed. STRUCTURAL FINDING retained from the prior draft, still accurate: this is legally a Visitor's Visa variant (Section 11(1)(b)(iv)), not a standalone digital-nomad category, and its full legislative history (introduced March 2024, revised via the Third Amendment 9 October 2024, operational for applications from March 2025) was not re-verified in this pass beyond what the DHA notice itself (dated 9 October 2024) confirms.
